draw_instance_predictions: draw instance-level prediction results with bounding boxes, masks, and labels on a video frame
draw_sem_seg: draw semantic segmentation results on a video frame using the VideoVisualizer
draw_panoptic_seg_predictions: draw panoptic segmentation predictions with semantic and instance masks on a video frame
assign_colors_naive_tracking: assign consistent colors to tracked instances across video frames using naive IOU-based heuristics
assign_colors_by_id: assign consistent colors to instances across video frames using stable instance IDs
